programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana
Martyna and her team circled the Earth once again.She reached places she had never been before.She visited, among others:Bhutan - a mysterious kingdom in the Himalayas, where the happiest people in the world live, and in Papua she lived in one village with the Dani population.When traveling long distances, the simplest activities turn out to be a challenge.Viewers will learn how to wash their hair when the temperature does not exceed 10 degrees and how to attach a microphone when the interlocutor's only clothing is a gourd.The traveler will check how the heroines of her previous expeditions are doing.He will also reveal the secrets of creating such a unique program.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna goes to Saint Petersburg, where she will meet Larisa Renar, who runs the Academy of Private Life.Women can find answers to all their questions about women's and men's issues there.Over 150,000 students have already completed courses conducted by Larisa - not only from Russia, but also from China, England, the United Arab Emirates, Bulgaria and Turkey.The heroine of the episode completed her MBA;is a psychologist, motivational trainer, and author of eight guides for women.For Russian women, whose salary is 1/3 less than men's, marriage has not only a romantic aspect, but also a business one.Hence the popularity of Larissa Academy.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Malaysia.There he meets with members of the Badjao community, which the rest of the world has not yet heard of.According to legends, their ancestors had gills.Currently, these people can stay underwater for several minutes on one breath and dive to a depth of 20-30 meters without any specialized equipment.The Badjao live on boats or in houses built on stilts.They spend their whole lives there, so when they come ashore, they get land sickness.Their children learn to swim before they can even walk.The traveler visits a local healer, Djirajniha, who enjoys great trust and respect.Thanks to it, Martyna Wojciechowska can get to know the extraordinary world of Badjao.

programs.title: Operation: FLIGHT
programs.desc: Documentarians present the behind-the-scenes work of Warsaw's Chopin Airport and LOT Polish Airlines.Together with the cameras, they will reach places where until now only staff members had access.The airport is a place where you cannot afford to make mistakes.Extraordinary safety requirements make each process equally important and extremely interesting.Viewers can finally see, among others:who supervises air traffic and how, what happens to luggage left before check-in, and how flight attendants prepare for each flight.Everything related to the operation of an airport requires perfect operation and planning.PLL LOT transports almost five million passengers annually.
